_comment: Pose vocabulary harvested by scrubbing every pack action at 6 frames per action (cast/grid-man.png, grid-woman.png in the task evidence). The men and women packs carry the SAME retargeted motions frame-for-frame, so one vocabulary serves both: compose.py prefixes the character's action_prefix (Man/Female). 'frame' is the hold frame frozen via NLA. seated carries floor_snap:false because the sitting action stores hip height in the pose itself.

presenting.reads_as: one hand raised — making a point, appeal, conversational challenge; the safe person-directed gesture

gesturing.reads_as: both hands up, engaging the room

seated.reads_as: seated at a desk/chair — REQUIRES the seat-contact probe (cinematography.md §5-6): place ~3-5cm behind chair center, z=0.02, verify hips on seat

hand-raised.reads_as: arm stretched overhead — asking a question

pointing.reads_as: arm extended forward at a THING — profile angles only, never aimed at a person (reads as a punch from 3/4-rear; see cinematography.md §4)

collapsed.reads_as: lying flat — 'the server is down' visual metaphor; use tastefully, never for people harm
